mapper.select: SELECT social_account_key, user_key, social_provider, social_provider_key, social_user_id, link_status, linked_dt, last_social_login_dt, created_dt, updated_dt FROM tb_social_account WHERE social_provider = #{provider} AND social_provider_key = #{providerUserId} AND link_status = 'LINKED' LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_social_account ( user_key, social_provider, social_provider_key, social_user_id, link_status, linked_dt, last_social_login_dt, created_dt, updated_dt ) VALUES ( #{userKey}, #{provider}, #{providerKey}, #{socialUserId}, #{linkStatus}, #{linkedDt}, #{lastSocialLoginDt}, #{createdDt}, #{updatedDt} )
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_social_account SET last_social_login_dt = #{lastSocialLoginDt}, updated_dt = NOW() WHERE social_account_key = #{socialAccountKey}
